faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the specification. The Autobiography Dynamic was offered with two engines: the SDV8 — a 4.4-litre V8 diesel — and the supercharged AJ-V8 — a 5.0-litre V8 petrol. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your car has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500 for the SDV8 diesel, or £5,500 for the supercharged AJ-V8. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Autobiography Dynamic?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the SDV8 or the AJ-V8 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every SDV8 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild AJ-V8 Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals and coolant components as standard on every AJ-V8 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
